sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Wide-Format Impressions provides authoritative coverage on industry trends and emerging technologies impacting the visual communications market with a focus on innovative, high-margin, wide-format digital inkjet applications.

Industry: Publishing · HQ: Philadelphia, PA, United States · Size: not published

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Wide-Format Impressions scores 46 of 100 (tier C) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (25/25), event engagement (11/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for industry fit and company size, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (24% similar on print, media, printing, graphics); Mactac (23% similar on printing, print, digital, media); ORAFOL Europe (11% similar on printing, digital, graphics, long-term). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
